verdict.rationale: Extend markets 'Composer & Review Agent' and 'Agent form filling' as built-in product features (extend-docs-20, extend-docs-28), suggesting some in-product agentic assistant capability, but there's no detailed documentation, screenshots, or independent confirmation of how a user actually delegates a task to a built-in assistant inside the app UI. Missing for 10: first-party docs/walkthrough of the in-product assistant UX, hands-on or community confirmation of delegating tasks to it, and clarity on how it differs from the document-processing agents users build themselves.
